general_information.name: SORRY — DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS? I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE WHOLE THING ALL AT ONCE. IT’S MARIA… UM, I THINK THAT’S THE FIRST PART.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s… been low mood mostly, and I’m so tired all the time. Everything feels overwhelming. I’m three weeks after having the baby, and I’m breastfeeding, and there’s my toddler too, and my husband is barely around, so it all sort of piles up.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to feel like myself again, and be able to cope better… and look after the kids without feeling like I’m drowning all the time.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and grew up… just here, really. That’s all I know to say.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School, and then working at the coffee shop… that’s mostly what I did. It’s a bit fuzzy when I try to sort it out.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married. My husband… he’s been pretty absent, not very supportive, and that’s been hard, especially now.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to care for my children and maybe return to work eventually.
